_comment: CodeScene Code Health rule tuning for PoRedoImage.
Thresholds that differ from CodeScene's defaults are justified inline via the sibling
_rationale keys. Anything not listed here keeps CodeScene's default behaviour on purpose -
silently relaxing rules would inflate the Code Health score the scorecard depends on.
_exclude_rationale: Generated and vendored code is not authored here, so its complexity is not a signal the team can act on.

rule_overrides._rationale: Minimal-API endpoint handlers legitimately carry request mapping plus validation plus the call. 70 lines still flags a genuinely oversized handler without penalising the vertical-slice style this repo uses deliberately.
Default is 9; kept explicit so a future bump is a visible decision rather than a drift.
Endpoint and service classes here take injected AI/vision/storage abstractions; 6 catches real god-objects while allowing the router+cache+logger triads that are normal in this codebase.

hotspot_thresholds._comment: Drives the High-Risk Hotspot Count the scorecard reads.
hotspot_thresholds._rationale: A file is a high-risk hotspot when it changes often AND its health is below 8.0 - frequency alone just identifies active code, which is not a defect.
